GHEC and PSAC are providing comments uses for funds from non-residential taxes:

Public Safety IT Projects: Funded through areawide levy
Used only on IT that is only used in MOA.

PSAC discussed at their meeting Aug 11, excerpted below:

MOA tax levy funds for Tourism Improvement Projects
Projects must be for promotion of tourism.
Ideas discussed:
    •   signage needs to direct visitors to trails and resources
    •   public restrooms in high density visitation areas, such as the Girdwood Station Mall
    •   trash service in high density visitation areas, such as Girdwood Station Mall
    •   additional signage to encourage visitors to use facilities such as the US Forest Service, which
       has restrooms and visitor information
    •   Potential for creating a rest-stop with restrooms along the highway north or south of
       Girdwood.

Motion:
PSAC moves to recommend that GBOS focus on TIPS projects to focus on trash and bathrooms,
starting at the entry to the valley near the Girdwood Station Mall.
Motion by DC/2nd LN
Motion carries by assent





TIPS (Tourism Improvement Projects): Funds collected from bed tax.
2027 funding is $1.5M

GHEC discussed at their meeting Aug 5, excerpted below

Motion:
GHEC moves to recommend to GBOS a Girdwood Tourism Projects Package of $100,000 for various
Girdwood projects, $50,000 for RV park study and $50,000 to be specified at the GBOS meeting.

Motion by KH/2nd MS
Motion carries 4-0
